locator.section: Sunday-within-the-Octave proper and Through our Lord cue on p. 393; ordinary Libera nos conclusion from Jesus Christ, thy Son through the duration formula on p. 29, excluding its same-Lord prefix and Libera nos body

entries.claim: Historical English basis of the complete Collect as a declared two-locus revision: the proper and Through our Lord cue on p. 393, completed by the ordinary conclusion on p. 29. Contemporary address, will-oriented request, coordinated service and duration are revised against the selected Latin. The different same-Lord prefix and the Libera nos body are not imported; neither page is claimed to print this entire contemporary Collect.
